name: services/blobbox/put_sha1
description:
Put a text blob into the database, using a SHA-1 hash.

Usually you will use this method after you upload a file with put_unsigned. However, you may also attempt to use this method if you have a reason to suspect that your content may already exist (or it existed recently) in our blobbox database. USOS API will try to find the content and if it succeeds, it will be linked to a new blob ID.

Please include an Access Token if you have one (why?)
brief_description: Put a blob into the database, using a SHA-1 hash.

arguments.name: sha1
arguments.description: SHA-1 hash of the data to be stored.

arguments.name: datasize
arguments.description: Length of the data, in bytes (for some extra security).

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.
